This is a finite certificate for all lengths because appending a bit can only create a forbidden suffix of length 4 or 6; the six distinct phases exhaust length eight and always have the periodic continuation. The two additional length-seven words make the onset sharp. Independently checked both distinct same-length returns for each of the three prescribed constraints (ternary joint and each binary single order), checking every factor in the seed plus each block and exact return of the maximal context. Any future crossing factor is then checked by the next return, so the choices concatenate freely and arbitrary remaining length is obtained by a prefix of one return. Counts are positive and submultiplicative by factoring a word at a fixed index, giving existence of entropy and the stated strict bounds.
